parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `EnvironmentValues` spread across five distinct packages — `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. Extending `EnvironmentValues` is the canonical SwiftUI pattern for injecting custom environment keys; each extension lives in the package that owns its key (e.g., `PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift`, `AccentColorEnvironment.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`). The structural collision is purely a consequence of every SwiftUI package extending the same SwiftUI type, not a sign of duplicated logic. Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated domain packages together and violate the package-boundary design already evident in the file layout. No restraint markers are present, but the coincidental-shape reason class applies because the shared shape encodes entirely unrelated domain concepts.
